en: A monochrome printed postcard showing a line drawing of a church complex in a valley landscape. The church has a tall, narrow bell tower with a pyramidal roof topped by a cross, and an attached basilica-style nave with a large circular window above the entrance. In front is an arcade of rounded arches. A road curves around the complex, and low hills or mountains rise in the background under large, stylized clouds. In the lower corners are small handwritten elements, including what appears to be a year and a signature.
